title: commit your way

verses.text: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

caption:
Trusting God with a choice is not the same as having no plan.

Psalm 37 does not ask you to stop moving. It asks you to put the weight somewhere else: trust Him, do good where you already are, and let your delight settle on Him rather than on the outcome. Then hand over the way. He has not forgotten what you are carrying.

Psalm 37:3, 37:4 and 37:5 (BSB)
